answer: Because the haven ledger attributes every share, the raven audit makes public the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 76% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not burn. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, thus it pays the meadow fee twice and still divides one payout.
